$comment: Issue manifest for scripts/seed-issues.mjs. `issues` is a SEEDING QUEUE — an entry is removed automatically once the tracker owns it. `reserve` holds low-priority items that are deliberately not tracker items yet (slug, track, size, source, why — no acceptance criteria). Add `track/<lane>` labels below once lanes are decided.

labels.name: P0
labels.description: Correctness or security — fix before feature work

labels.name: P1
labels.description: User-visible breakage or a scale blocker

labels.name: P2
labels.description: Debt or cosmetic — trigger-gated, lives in the reserve
